scope: synthetic lossless normal-incidence AR, no claims for real materials
cost_work_note: wavelength_layer_products is an interface-equivalent work proxy, with max(1,N); not literal layer updates, FLOPs, or matched runtime
source_power_kernel_provenance: Exact unchanged copy of run_experiment.py from the earlier verified synthetic coating-search experiment, 2026-10-19; bundled for portable offline reproduction

config.midpoint_audit: 2048 disjoint interior midpoints plus mandatory endpoints; union maximum used for all labels
config.response: Re/Im r at common reference; no imposed phase target
config.constraints: every wavelength R <= .01; same-material neighbors canonicalized; positive layers >= .05 um; all candidate and repair layers obey case upper bound, 1.2 or .4 um
config.repair: SLSQP epigraph min t, all R_q <= t; best actual legal iterate retained

top1.calls_note: equal per-candidate refinement cap, not equal end-to-end actual cost; finite-power baseline needs no amplitudes/J; projected methods and KKT-dual reconstruction charged for J; dense audit excluded but separately counted
